channel.title: Tanzania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tanzania, every source cited.

item.title: Tanzania marks one year since deadly election violence
item.description: Thousands killed in protests suppressed by security forces, with victims still traumatised and critics facing charges.

item.title: Tanzania permanent secretary urges reduced sugar, salt, and fat intake
item.description: Dr Grace Magembe advised citizens to eat natural foods and exercise regularly to prevent non-communicable diseases.

item.title: Tanzania opens government city in Dodoma
item.description: The new administrative capital in Mtumba now houses ministries and includes electric vehicle charging stations.

item.title: Kenyan court orders police to produce missing Tanzanian activist
item.description: Justice Alexander Muasya Muteti ordered police to present Twaha Mwaipaya in court on November 2, 2026, or explain his detention.

item.title: Tanzania, Angola sign four deals to boost trade
item.description: Leaders aim to turn 50 years of solidarity into economic ties with agreements on air services and technology.
